dimension_description: Electric charge measures how much net positive or negative charge a system carries. Some entries are direct physical charges like the elementary charge, while others are derived from capacities, battery ratings, or stored-energy assumptions. This dimension is useful for connecting microscopic charges, static electricity, capacitors, storms, and batteries on one logarithmic axis.
